zh: 一个数是 k 的非负整数次幂，当且仅当能用 k 不断整除它直到变成 1；1 本身是 k⁰，也要计入。
对每个数，只要它大于 1 且能被 k 整除就除以 k；k≥2 保证每次都严格变小，最多除 log_k(10^9) 次，总耗时很小。
逐个读入数值，反复用 k 整除，直到不能整除或已经变成 1；最终等于 1 就计数加一。重复出现的数分别计数，最后输出计数。
en: A number is a non-negative integer power of k exactly when dividing it by k over and over reaches 1; 1 itself is k^0 and must be counted too.
For each number, divide by k as long as it is greater than 1 and divisible by k; k >= 2 guarantees it shrinks every time, so there are at most log_k(10^9) divisions and the total work is small.
Read the values one by one, divide each by k repeatedly until it is no longer divisible or has become 1, and count it if it ends at exactly 1. Duplicates are counted separately; print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Repeatedly divide each number by the factor k, and count it when it finally equals 1.

## Why it is correct

k>=2, so every exact division strictly decreases the value. Dividing down to exactly 1 is equivalent to the original number being a non-negative integer power of k; 1 needs no division and is k^0.

## Complexity

Time O(n log_k M), extra space O(1).
